styles.label: Word behind head
styles.best_for: The keyword in huge glowing caps behind the speaker's head, plain captions lower down.
styles.source: Pinterest 'AREN'T BORING' (4 Visual Hooks for Social Media); Tommy's Pin 4.8 s 'content'; REFERENCE-SPEC.md H2
styles.how: Each starred word gets its own line (two lines max, the 'AREN'T / BORING' stack), heavy caps (Archivo Black on VIDPOD, brand bold otherwise), tracking -0.02em, line pitch 1.3x cap height, widest line fitted to 920 px. The head (base.face.hook_top or top) covers the lower 55 % of the last line's caps. Fill in the picked colour with a three-step glow of the same colour (0.05em at 90 %, 0.2em at 55 %, 0.55em at 28 %). Each line lands on its spoken word: opacity 0 to 1, scale 1.07 to 1, blur 6 to 0 px over 0.32 s expo.out; the stack drifts 1 to 1.03 linear; a new hook line swaps the stack (0.14 s fade). Captions: the spoken words, lowercase, brand bold 84 px white with a soft shadow, centred at y 1330, three words at a time, each word on its timestamp. Headroom: if the clip is framed too tight for the layout, the plate and its person matte move down together by the amount needed (max 420 px) for the whole hook; the gap above is the plate's top rows above the head, flipped and stretched, blur 3 px. It eases back over 0.5 s power2.inOut, starting 0.55 s before the hook ends.

styles.label: Mixed-scale stack
styles.best_for: One huge glowing keyword over the chest, the small words tucked into its gaps, built as they speak.
styles.source: Tommy's Pin 0-1.7 s 'If the / Prospects / have to / meet you' (PaidPro Digital); REFERENCE-SPEC.md H1
styles.how: Per hook line with a *keyword*: the keyword in brand bold, tracking -0.03em, up to 230 px and fitted to 900 px; small words at 0.36x in brand bold white, tracking -0.01em, 94 % opacity, soft dark shadow. The keyword's glyphs are measured: lead words go top left, sitting down into the ascender zone over a run of x-height letters when one is wide enough (else their baseline kisses the cap line); more lead words (or long follow words) go top right the same way; follow words go under the right end where there are no descenders. Rows that would touch step a line up (above) or down (below). Glow: a blurred copy of the keyword (blur 0.09em, opacity 0.95 then 0.6) under the sharp word, plus a soft dark bloom (radial, 34 % at the centre) behind the stack so it reads on light clothes. Motion: small words opacity 0 to 0.94, y 10 to 0 over 0.14 s power2.out on their words; keyword scale 1.12 to 1, blur 8 to 0, opacity 0 to 1 over 0.22 s expo.out, glow pulse; stacks hard cut to the next line; a stack never appears more than 1.8 s before its keyword.

styles.label: Serif keyword
styles.best_for: Editorial pair: the lead words in heavy caps, the keyword huge in a serif behind the speaker's head.
styles.source: Pinterest editorial reel 'THE HARDEST PART OF MAKING CONTENT ISN'T posting...' (jordanssarchives) and serif keyword reels (refs/hooks 02, 03)
styles.how: Per hook line with a *keyword*: the keyword in the brand's serif or script display face (Brand Display on @pilates; DM Serif Display where the brand display is a heavy sans), tracking -0.02em, up to 260 px fitted to 960 px, in the picked colour, soft shadow. Lead words in heavy caps (Archivo Black on VIDPOD), white (or the second colour), 0.46x the keyword size (64 to 124 px), one or two centred lines, pitch 1.22x cap height.
